description: This file defines a class AzureOpenAIO1Config that customizes configuration and behavior for Azure's O-series OpenAI models, including parameter filtering, streaming support, and model identification. It extends existing configurations and adds Azure-specific logic for handling models like o1, o3, and o4.

classes.name: AzureOpenAIO1Config
classes.description: A configuration class for Azure's O-series OpenAI models, providing parameter support, streaming behavior, and model identification tailored for Azure deployments.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of OpenAI parameters supported by Azure O-series models, excluding unsupported ones.

methods.name: list _get_o_series_only_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Helper method to determine O-series-only parameters, especially 'reasoning_effort' based on model recognition and support.

methods.name: bool should_fake_stream( self, model: Optional[str], stream: Optional[bool], custom_llm_provider: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Determines whether to fake streaming for a given model, based on model features and support info.

methods.name: bool is_o_series_model(self, model: str)
methods.description: Checks if a given model name corresponds to an O-series model.

methods.name: dict transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms the request parameters, especially handling model name prefixes related to O-series deployment.
